posts.text: $CLX goes ex-dividend today with a 23-year payout streak. The 5.72% yield sits well above its 5-year average of 3.21%, a notable shift for the consumer staples name.
$DEO lowered its annual dividend from 3.32 to 2.00 USD, a 39.8% cut announced in October. The data classifies the safety of the current payout as safe.
$NKE shows a current yield of 4.37%, more than 3 times its 5-year average of 1.41%. The company has maintained its dividend for 23 consecutive years.
PAX Global (0327.HK) cut its HKD-denominated dividend by 75.8% in October 2026. Despite the reduction, the company maintains a 6-year dividend growth streak.
$DKS appears as a fast grower with 5-year dividend growth of 31.1%. Its current yield of 3.53% is 1.6 times its 5-year average yield of 2.2%.
$PSX raised its annual dividend rate from 5.08 to 5.32 USD. The energy sector company has a 4-year streak and a 5-year yield average of 3.99%.
$TXN goes ex-dividend on Oct 30 with a 22-year streak. The 1.97% yield is slightly below its 5-year average of 2.71%, reflecting recent price action.
